skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will develop skills in selecting and executing research on specialized topics, applying theoretical knowledge to practical situations.
Students will enhance their ability to analyze and solve problems in the real estate sector using critical thinking.
Students will improve their communication skills, including presenting their work and defending their viewpoints.
Students will learn to manage projects, including planning, organizing, and executing research activities.
Students will develop the ability to self-learn and continuously improve their professional skills.
Students will work collaboratively in teams and take responsibility for their roles.
Students will understand and adhere to professional ethics and academic integrity.
Students will apply economic theories to real-world problems in the real estate sector.
Students will gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills in the real estate industry, including business, management, valuation, and brokerage.
Students will understand and apply relevant laws and regulations in the real estate sector.
